caveats: Competition pool: 6 low-split competitions with small non-image-heavy data (detecting-insults, jigsaw-toxic, leaf-classification, nomad2018, random-acts-of-pizza, spooky); 5 drawn by random.Random(20260926).sample. n=5 so the CI is very wide.
Agent is a few-step script writer (<=3 attempts, retry only on crash/missing submission), CPU only, 20-min run cap, no validation loop; not the MLE-bench AIDE/OpenHands scaffolds, 24h budget or GPU.
detecting-insults submission was invalid (agent omitted the required Comment column) and counts as a failure.
Only medal: nomad2018 (silver, RMSLE 0.05914). spooky logloss 1.07 is near uniform-prior level.
colab_units is an upper-bound estimate (~8 min of one CPU runtime); the colab CLI does not report unit usage.
New arm; not pooled with the 2026-09-05 40/75 graded campaign (different actor, scaffold, and competitions).
Paired vLLM arm: identical items, prompts (chat template, enable_thinking=False), temperature 0, max_tokens, harness and grader as the Tinker-base run; only endpoint/model id changed.
modal_usd not attributed per lane (shared GPU bill reconciled by lead).

nomad2018: identical prompt (46.8k tokens, due to the harness listing ~3k per-id geometry subdirs) exceeds the endpoint max-model-len 32768, so all 3 attempts got HTTP 400 in BOTH vLLM arms -> no submission -> failure (protocol error rule). The Tinker-base arm (no such limit) medalled on it; this is an engine context-limit difference, identical across the paired arms.
vllm_tokens includes the 3x ~46.8k rejected nomad2018 prompt tokens per arm (never processed).
Two Colab CPU sessions (e9-mle-tr, e9-mle-base) ran in parallel; both stopped. colab_units is an upper-bound estimate.
